words.definition: The courses or subjects that make up a student's program of study
words.definationTranslation: Vidyaarthi ke adhyayan kaaryakram ke banane wale pustakein ya vishay

sentence.sentence: The school's curriculum includes a wide range of extracurricular activities.
sentence.translation: School ke pathyaakram mein kai prakaar ke bahriksha vidyaayatan shamil hain.

sentence.sentence: The new curriculum will be introduced next semester.
sentence.translation: Naya pathyaakram agle semester mein laya jayega.

words.definition: The science or art of teaching
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan ka vigyaan ya kala

sentence.sentence: The pedagogy used in this school is very effective.
sentence.translation: Is school mein upyog ki gayi shikshavidhi bahut prabhaavi hai.

sentence.sentence: The teacher's pedagogy was focused on student-centered learning.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ki shikshavidhi vidyaarthi-kendraakrit shikshan par kendrit thi.

words.definition: The process of evaluating or judging the quality or capability of something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ki gunvatta ya kshamta ka mulyaan karne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The teacher used various methods of assessment to evaluate the students.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyaarthiyon ka mulyankan karne ke liye kai tarah ke tareekon ka upyog kiya.

sentence.sentence: The assessment of the student's performance was based on the project.
sentence.translation: Vidyaarthi ki pradarshan ka mulyankan project par aadharit tha.

words.definition: A scoring guide used to evaluate the quality of a student's work
words.definationTranslation: Vidyaarthi ke kaary ki gunvatta ka mulyaan karne ke liye upyog kiya jaane wala ankadaan margdarshak

sentence.sentence: The teacher used a rubric to assess the students' projects.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyaarthiyon ke project ka mulyaan karne ke liye ek mulyankan patr ka upyog kiya.

sentence.sentence: The rubric was clear and easy to understand.
sentence.translation: Mulyankan patr spasht aur samajhne mein aasan tha.

words.definition: A document that outlines the content and structure of a course
words.definationTranslation: Ek dastavez jo course ke vishayvaastu aur sanrachna ka ullekh karta hai

sentence.sentence: The professor handed out the syllabus on the first day of class.
sentence.translation: Professor ne pehle din hi pathyaavali baant di.

sentence.sentence: The syllabus was very detailed and informative.
sentence.translation: Pathyaavali bahut vivaranpoorn aur jaanakaari se bhari thi.

words.definition: Work assigned to students as part of a course
words.definationTranslation: Vidyaarthiyon ko pathyaakram ke hisse ke roop mein saup di gayi kaarya

sentence.sentence: The coursework was challenging but rewarding.
sentence.translation: Pathyaakram kaarya kathin tha lekin puraskar se bhara hua tha.

sentence.sentence: The student completed all the coursework on time.
sentence.translation: Vidyaarthi ne samay par poora pathyaakram kaarya poora kiya.

words.definition: A self-contained part of a course or program
words.definationTranslation: Ek course ya program ka swa-gherat bhag

sentence.sentence: The course was divided into several modules.
sentence.translation: Course ko kai module mein vibhaajit kiya gaya tha.

sentence.sentence: The module on marketing was very interesting.
sentence.translation: Vipanan module bahut rochak tha.

words.definition: A unit of measurement for the amount of work required to complete a course
words.definationTranslation: Ek course poora karne ke liye aavashyak kaarya ki matra ka maap

sentence.sentence: The course was worth three credits.
sentence.translation: Course tin ank ke barabar tha.

sentence.sentence: The student earned enough credits to graduate.
sentence.translation: Vidyaarthi ne snaatak hone ke liye paryaapt ank praapt kiye.

words.definition: The process of evaluating student performance and assigning grades
words.definationTranslation: Vidyaarthi ki pradarshan ka mulyaan karna aur ank dene ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The teacher was fair in her grading.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ankdaan mein nyayapaarna thi.

sentence.sentence: The grading system was based on a curve.
sentence.translation: Ankdaan pranaali ek vakra par aadharit thi.

words.definition: The process of determining the quality or value of something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ki gunvatta ya maulya ka nirdharan karne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The evaluation of the project was based on several criteria.
sentence.translation: Project ka mulyaan kai maanakon par aadharit tha.

sentence.sentence: The teacher's evaluation was fair and constructive.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ka mulyaan nyayapaarna aur nirmanatmak tha.

words.definition: The process of acquiring new knowledge or skills
words.definationTranslation: Naye gyaan ya kaushal praapt karne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: Learning is a lifelong process.
sentence.translation: Shikshan ek jeevanbhar ka prakriya hai.

sentence.sentence: The student enjoyed the learning experience.
sentence.translation: Vidyaarthi ko shikshan anubhav ka aanand aaya.

words.definition: A device or method used to evaluate student learning
words.definationTranslation: Vidyaarthi ki shikshan ka mulyaan karne ke liye upyog kiya jaane wala yantar ya tareeka

sentence.sentence: The teacher used a variety of assessment tools to evaluate student learning.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyaarthi ki shikshan ka mulyaan karne ke liye kai prakaar ke mulyaan ke yantraon ka upyog kiya.

sentence.sentence: The assessment tool was easy to use and provided accurate results.
sentence.translation: Mulyaan ka yantra aasan tha upyog karne mein aur satik parinaam pradaan kar raha tha.

words.definition: The ability to do something successfully or efficiently
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ko safaltapurvak ya kaushal se karne ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: The student demonstrated competency in the subject.
sentence.translation: Vidyaarthi ne vishay mein kshamta ka pradarshan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The teacher evaluated the student's competency in writing.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyaarthi ki likhit kshamta ka mulyaan kiya.

words.definition: The process of creating and improving educational programs
words.definationTranslation: Shikshanatmak programon ka nirman aur unnati karne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The curriculum development team worked hard to create a new program.
sentence.translation: Pathyaakram vikas team ne naye program ka nirman karne ke liye kadi mehnat ki.

sentence.sentence: The curriculum development process was ongoing and continuous.
sentence.translation: Pathyaakram vikas prakriya nirantar chal rahi thi.

words.definition: The process of creating and improving instructional materials and programs
words.definationTranslation: Shikshanatmak saamagri aur programon ka nirman aur unnati karne ka prakriya

sentence.sentence: The instructional design team created a new online course.
sentence.translation: Shikshanatmak sanrachna team ne ek naya online course banaya.

sentence.sentence: The instructional design process was based on learner-centered principles.
sentence.translation: Shikshanatmak sanrachna prakriya vidyaarthi-kendraakrit siddhanton par aadharit thi.

words.definition: The use of technology to support and enhance teaching and learning
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan aur shikshan ko sanarthit aur sudharne ke liye praudyogiki ka upyog

sentence.sentence: The school invested in new educational technology to improve student outcomes.
sentence.translation: School ne vidyaarthi parinaamon mein sudhar karne ke liye nayi shikshan praudyogiki mein nivesh kiya.

sentence.sentence: The teacher integrated educational technology into her classroom.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne apne classroom mein shikshan praudyogiki ko samanvit kiya.

words.definition: A technique or approach used to teach and learn
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan aur shikshan ke liye upyog kiya jaane wala tareeka ya drishtikon

sentence.sentence: The teacher used a variety of teaching methods to engage students.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyaarthiyon ko aakarshit karne ke liye kai shikshan kaaryaon ka upyog kiya.

sentence.sentence: The teaching method was based on student-centered learning.
sentence.translation: Shikshan kaarya vidyaarthi-kendraakrit shikshan par aadharit tha.

words.definition: The degree to which students are involved and interested in their learning
words.definationTranslation: Vidyaarthi apne shikshan mein kitne shamil hain aur roochikar rahe hain

sentence.sentence: The teacher encouraged student engagement through interactive activities.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne sakriya gatividhiyon ke maadhyam se vidyaarthi aakarshan ko protsahit kiya.

sentence.sentence: The student engagement was high in the project-based learning environment.
sentence.translation: Project-aadhaarit shikshan vaataavaran mein vidyaarthi aakarshan uchha tha.

words.definition: Information or reaction to a product, service, or performance
words.definationTranslation: Uttapadan, seva, ya pradarshan ke liye jaankari ya pratikriya

sentence.sentence: The teacher provided feedback to the students on their projects.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyaarthiyon ko unke project par pratiprasaar diya.

sentence.sentence: The feedback was helpful in improving the student's performance.
sentence.translation: Pratiprasaar vidyaarthi ki pradarshan mein sudhar karne mein madadgar tha.

words.definition: An ongoing, flexible, and more formal process of evaluating student learning
words.definationTranslation: Vidyaarthi shikshan ka mulyaan karne ka nirantar, lachilaa, aur adhik aavadh prakriya

sentence.sentence: The teacher used formative assessment to monitor student progress.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne vidyaarthi ki pragati ka nireekshan karne ke liye roopatmak mulyankan ka upyog kiya.

sentence.sentence: The formative assessment was an essential part of the teaching process.
sentence.translation: Roopatmak mulyankan shikshan prakriya ka ek mahatvapoorn hissa tha.

words.definition: A periodic, more comprehensive process of evaluating student learning at the end of an instructional unit
words.definationTranslation: Ek shikshanik ikai ke ant mein vidyaarthi shikshan ka mulyaan karne ka samay-samay par, adhik vivechak prakriya

sentence.sentence: The teacher used summative assessment to evaluate student learning at the end of the semester.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak ne samikshatmak mulyankan ka upyog semester ke ant mein vidyaarthi shikshan ka mulyaan karne ke liye kiya.

sentence.sentence: The summative assessment provided a comprehensive picture of student learning.
sentence.translation: Samikshatmak mulyankan ne vidyaarthi shikshan ka vivechak chitra pradaan kiya.
